items.name: agent-memory
items.title: Agent memory
items.description: What the agent remembers about you, in plain sentences you can edit, forget, undo or switch off.

items.name: approval-step
items.title: Approval step
items.description: A human-in-the-loop gate that scales friction with the risk of the action.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat thread
items.description: A flat, readable conversation between a person and an agent, with references, files, hand-offs and unread markers.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Inline numbered sources that open the exact quote, and a visible flag on any claim that has none.

items.name: confidence-badge
items.title: Confidence badge
items.description: A plain-language signal for how sure the agent is, with a reason and a next step.

items.name: error-recovery
items.title: Error recovery
items.description: Says what failed, what survived and what to do next, with a visible auto-retry and a way forward when retrying stops helping.

items.name: feedback-thumbs
items.title: Feedback thumbs
items.description: One-tap rating that asks for a reason only after a thumbs-down.

items.name: human-handoff
items.title: Human hand-off
items.description: Passes a chat to a person with the context attached, a real queue position, and a way out when no one is there.

items.name: interrupt-steer
items.title: Interrupt and steer
items.description: A composer that stays live while the agent works, so you redirect it mid-run.

items.name: plan-preview
items.title: Plan preview
items.description: The agent proposes steps. You edit, reorder or remove them before it runs.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: A chat-style message box for agents: / commands, @ context, image paste, voice, and mode and model in a row under the box. Built for phones as well as desktops.

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming response
items.description: Text that arrives as it is written, with stop, retry and a clear failure state.

items.name: tool-timeline
items.title: Tool-call timeline
items.description: A step-by-step record of what the agent did, with real outcomes, including failures.

items.name: why-this-answer
items.title: Why this answer
items.description: An expandable panel with reasoning steps and quotable sources.
